decisions.reason: The Hero V refinement remains consistent with the existing visually balanced, holistic brand expression and does not change its broader brand-level requirements.
The source changes the internal composition of the Hero V, not the deferred complete-wordmark rhythm, kerning, or hierarchy.
The second V must still derive from the resolved Hero V, but the source does not initiate its development or alter that derivation rule.
The source refines the Hero V arm relationship without changing or resuming the deferred É-accent derivation requirement.
The source concerns black-and-white Hero V geometry and does not change the deferred champagne-metal material treatment or its role.
The source continues refinement within the Hero V family and does not change or resume the deferred remaining wordmark letterforms.
The requested additional right-arm reach changes the Hero V arm geometry, while the existing structural, deliberate, non-decorative terminal-language constraints remain valid unchanged.
Refining the Hero V silhouette does not alter the requirement for a wordmark-led identity without a separate icon or monogram.
